This batch resolves three open comparisons for the boosting family: whether a slower learning rate at the same leaf capacity (0.07) improves over 0.2, whether more capacity (63 leaves) helps or overfits 617 training rows, and whether a faster rate with stronger L2 shrinkage trades bias for variance usefully. Results directly set the second decision: refine within boosting or invest in the kernel direction. Unverified expectation only; losses are measured on one fixed 188-row development split and imply no optimum.
